ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.EnableValidationRule__c.Flag_To_Prevent_SR_Hierarchy_Type__c = FALSE, $Permission.QC_Support_Team, OR( NOT( OR( ISPICKVAL(sales_h_eq_type__c , "Contract Group"), ISPICKVAL(sales_h_eq_type__c , "Consolidator"))), ISBLANK(TEXT(sales_h_eq_type__c))) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Channel Support Team should select the Sales Hierarchy Type as "Consolidator" OR "Contract Group"
